name: io.github.python1/verified-memory
title: Verified Memory
description: Offline read-only search over a checksum-verified, optionally signed memory pack, with exact quotes

packageArguments.name: --pack
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to a pack directory containing exactly MEMORY.md, README.md, records.jsonl and SHA256SUMS, plus an optional PACK.json (creation and expiry dates) and SHA256SUMS.sig. The whole pack is verified at startup; the server refuses to start if any check fails.

packageArguments.name: --trusted-keys
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to a file of public keys you trust to sign packs, one per line: name ssh-ed25519 AAAA… [comment]. A pack signed by a listed key reports that signer; a valid signature by any other key is reported as untrusted.

packageArguments.name: --trusted-fingerprint
packageArguments.description: Recommended for signed packs. The SHA256:… fingerprint of a key allowed to sign packs, as ssh-keygen -l prints it; repeat the flag (or separate with commas) for several. If set, only a pack signed by one of these keys is accepted, whatever --trusted-keys says. Implies --require-signature.

packageArguments.name: --revoked-keys
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to a file of revoked key fingerprints, one SHA256:… per line. A pack signed by a revoked key is always refused, even if pinned or trusted.

packageArguments.name: --min-sequence
packageArguments.description: Refuse any pack whose signed PACK.json sequence is missing or lower than N, so an older validly signed pack cannot replace a newer one. Implies --require-signature. No state is kept: raise N yourself when you install a newer pack.

packageArguments.name: --require-signature
packageArguments.description: Set to true to refuse to start unless the pack is signed by a pinned (--trusted-fingerprint) or trusted (--trusted-keys) key. Freshness is reported but not enforced. When false or omitted, unsigned packs load and are reported as unsigned.

packageArguments.name: --strict
packageArguments.description: Set to true to refuse to start (and to stop serving) unless the pack is signed by a pinned (--trusted-fingerprint) or trusted (--trusted-keys) key and is fresh: PACK.json present and not expired. Implies --require-signature. When false or omitted, undated and stale packs load and every result reports their status.
